For a year and a half I sold enterprise Java software as a sales engineer, to
developers, managers, and VP and C-suite executives alongside a dedicated rep. I
delivered over 30 sales presentations and helped close $50M. This is the other
side of the table: an engineer who can carry the technical credibility into the
room and still speak to what the business is actually buying. It is a large part
of why I read both engineers and executives well, and why a technical
recommendation from me lands as a business decision rather than a preference.
